description: This file contains test scripts for verifying Git merge message generation, including various merge scenarios such as branch merges, octopus merges, tag merges, ambiguous tags, and remote-tracking branch merges.

methods.name: check_oneline
methods.description: Verifies that the latest git log message matches the expected string.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with a specified message.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output in test assertions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script; reports results.
